# Prepare and clear a customs shipment

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

A reviewed shipment declaration and release record reconciled to duties, transport and retained supporting evidence.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source checked on 2026-11-01. No case-specific legal review, independent professional assurance or completed execution is claimed. Sources establish regional entry points; determine the actual applicable local route with qualified reviewers.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Assemble the shipment and customs facts

agent-runnable


Collect origin, destination, transit route, goods descriptions, quantities, values, commercial invoices and transport records. Identify importer, exporter, buyer, seller and proposed representative; missing destination or responsible-party facts block preparation.

- Sources: [HMRC EORI registration process](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-eori/registration-process) · [GOV.UK import goods into the UK step by step](https://www.gov.uk/import-goods-into-uk)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Confirm registration and the customs procedure

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The customs owner or qualified broker confirms the responsible trader, required registrations, classification, origin, valuation, restrictions and procedure for the actual route. EORI registration alone does not clear goods; Northern Ireland, temporary movements and controlled goods require separate assessment.

- Sources: [HMRC EORI registration process](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-eori/registration-process) · [GOV.UK import goods into the UK step by step](https://www.gov.uk/import-goods-into-uk)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the declaration and supporting dossier

agent-runnable


Prepare the declaration data and document checklist under the broker-approved classification and procedure. Reconcile quantities and values to commercial records and flag missing licences, certificates, origin evidence or inconsistent transport instructions.

- Sources: [HMRC EORI registration process](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-eori/registration-process) · [GOV.UK import goods into the UK step by step](https://www.gov.uk/import-goods-into-uk)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the declaration and representation mandate

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The accountable trader approves the exact declaration data, broker mandate, payment arrangements and shipment instructions. Resolve missing permits and uncertain classifications before submission; do not infer that a carrier accepts importer responsibility.

- Sources: [HMRC EORI registration process](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-eori/registration-process) · [GOV.UK import goods into the UK step by step](https://www.gov.uk/import-goods-into-uk)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Submit and coordinate customs release

human · human approval required · irreversible


The authorized declarant or broker submits through the applicable customs route, handles official requests and arranges approved duty or tax payment. Retain declaration references and release or hold messages; physical delivery alone does not establish customs acceptance.

- Sources: [HMRC EORI registration process](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-eori/registration-process) · [GOV.UK import goods into the UK step by step](https://www.gov.uk/import-goods-into-uk)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Reconcile release and retain the audit record

agent-runnable


Match accepted declarations, release evidence and paid or deferred amounts to the shipment and ledger. Assign amendments, returns, transit discharge and rejected declarations to their owners and preserve the applicable supporting records.

- Verify: A reviewed shipment declaration and release record reconciled to duties, transport and retained supporting evidence.
- Sources: [HMRC EORI registration process](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-eori/registration-process) · [GOV.UK import goods into the UK step by step](https://www.gov.uk/import-goods-into-uk)
